text:
Talia Benson: Kickoff logistics thread for the FP8/INT8 kernel benchmarking sprint. Dropping initial links + owner calls so we can get Week 1 moving.

Talia Benson: Charter (please skim, esp success metrics + artifacts): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ENGSERVE/FP8+INT8+Benchmarking+Sprint+Charter

Talia Benson: Working notes doc (add daily notes / questions here): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/redwood/engineering/serving-runtime/fp8-int8-sprint-notes-working-doc

Rina Kobayashi: :thumbsup: thanks. For harness owners: Noah + I can own benchmark spec + harness changes. I’ll post a checklist later today.

Noah Patel: Confirmed. Also want a quick alignment on “top hosted” model list + traffic shapes so we don’t keep re-running the matrix.

Hiro Tanaka: Kernel side: Grace / Yuki / Isabella will be on point for FP8/INT8 microbench + selector logging. I’ll handle any cross-team escalation.

Sofia Ivanova: Scheduling: Lena / Marcus / Julian will own scheduler experiment matrix (prefill/decode interleave + batch caps), plus instrumentation for queue wait.

Sean Gallagher: Perf-lab note: A100 + H100 capacity is ok this week, but anything H200/L40S needs heads up so we can reserve nodes. Contention has been rough during peak PST.

Allison Grant: For dashboards/metrics, I can draft a spec today. Need to settle tag conventions (model family, quant mode, runtime commit, GPU SKU, region).

Talia Benson: Great. Initial proposal for Week 1 baseline matrix (open to edits):
- GPUs: A100-80GB, H100-SXM (and H200 + L40S “if available”)
- Quant modes: FP16 baseline, FP8 (attention+GEMM where supported), INT8 (GEMM path + any attention kernels we have)
- Serving scenarios: (1) offline microbench (GEMM/attn), (2) end-to-end hosted-style runs (TTFT/TPOT + throughput)

Noah Patel: +1. For model shortlist, suggest:
- Llama 3.1 8B (chat) + Llama 3.1 70B (chat)
- Qwen2.5 7B + Qwen2.5 32B
- Mistral Small (or 7B-ish) and one larger Mistral-family model if we’re still serving it broadly
We can tune exact SKUs to what’s in the hosted catalog.

Arjun Desai: From quant profiles side: Llama + Qwen are the safest coverage set. Mistral has a couple layers that are more drift-sensitive depending on scaling. I can mark “known sensitive prompts” once prompt sets are locked.

Grace Kim: For FP8, we should be explicit about e4m3 vs e5m2 and accumulation. If we’re comparing apples-to-apples across GPUs, we need to pin the FP8 policy in the harness config.

Yuki Sato: Also: kernel auto-selector logging. If we don’t log chosen kernel + shapes + quant mode, debugging regressions is going to be guesswork.

Isabella Rossi: Re microbench: I can put together a standard microbench set (matmul shapes from real prefill/decode) and run with fixed clocks. Need Sean’s guidance on “approved” clock/power settings in perf-lab.

Sean Gallagher: For fixed clocks: we can do application clocks on A100/H100 nodes, but it’s not uniform across the fleet images. I’ll post the blessed commands and which nodes allow it. (We should pin driver/CUDA/container digest either way.)

Rina Kobayashi: Can we lock an initial “top hosted” workload profile?
- Prefill-heavy: long prompt / shorter decode
- Decode-heavy: short prompt / longer decode
- Mixed: a realistic distribution (p50-ish) + some long-context tails
Also streaming vs non-streaming.

Sofia Ivanova: For scheduling experiments, we specifically want mixed prompt lengths + streaming because tail latency is where policies bite. I’ll propose a small matrix so it’s not combinatorial.

Connor O'Brien: Release side: please flag early which changes you think are safe to ship behind flags vs need more bake time. If we add canary gating, I need the pass/fail thresholds defined in the same sprint.

Allison Grant: For dashboards, I’ll assume the primary panels:
- TTFT p50/p95 (streaming)
- TPOT p50/p95 (streaming)
- tokens/sec aggregate + per-GPU
- queue wait p95 split prefill/decode
- kernel IDs/top-k ops by time (if spans enabled)
If someone has preferred metric naming, reply here.

Noah Patel: Re model list: can we decide today and I’ll update the matrix doc? Also agree we should include at least one “long context” config (8k/16k) to catch prefill regressions.

Talia Benson: Action items from this thread:
1) Noah/Rina: post proposed model + workload matrix EOD + link here
2) Sean: post perf-lab reservation guidance + clock/pinning notes
3) Allison: post dashboard tag convention proposal
4) Hiro/Sofia: confirm DRI list + week 1 check-in cadence

Hiro Tanaka: DRI list confirmed. For cadence: daily 15-min standup in #eng-runtime during Week 1 (async updates ok), and a longer readout Thu.

Sofia Ivanova: Works. I’ll drop a scheduler experiment doc link once drafted.

Rina Kobayashi: I’ll add a “baseline run checklist” section to the working doc (warmup, repetitions, outlier handling) so we’re consistent.

Talia Benson: Perfect. Keep using this thread for kickoff logistics / links so the channel doesn’t get spammed. :pray:
